record.question: Which University in the Northeastern States recently got 'A' Grade from NAAC?
record.explanation: Answer D: Mizoram University. Mizoram University received its first NAAC A grade on 21 February 2014 with CGPA 3.12. Its original 2013–14 annual report records that recent award. The word recently anchors this to the February 2014 event, not a claim that no other listed university ever held an A grade. Historical/source note: The recent February 2014 award to Mizoram University, not an exclusive all-time grade distinction among northeastern universities. Reference: https://mzu.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/Annual%20Reports/English/mzu_annual_report_2013-14english.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
